source_basis.predecessor_source_reuse: Pure mathematical/computational continuation of the role-local sign-clock and pair-cost model; no new external empirical claim introduced.

assumptions: Before each paired observation, the discordance hazard rho_t is measurable from past observed history only and satisfies rho_t>=rho_min=.20.
The current latent discordant sign is not observed or used to choose rho_t before deciding whether the current pair is discordant.
Conditional on a discordance, the sign law used by the sign-clock FWER/power calculation is preserved.
No hard pair cap terminates evaluation before the sign-clock curtailed boundary.
pathwise_coupling_result.construction: Use one shared Uniform(0,1) U_t per pair. The rho=.20 benchmark declares a discordance when U_t<=.20. The adaptive process declares a discordance when U_t<=rho_t. Since rho_t>=.20 pathwise, every benchmark discordance is also an adaptive discordance at the same pair index. Therefore N_adaptive(t)>=N_benchmark(t) for all t, so the j-th adaptive discordance occurs no later than the j-th benchmark discordance. Attach the same j-th sign Z_j to both sign clocks. Any stopping rule that depends only on the first D discordant signs then has identical D under the two clocks and adaptive total pair cost is pathwise <= the fixed-rho=.20 benchmark cost.
pathwise_coupling_result.consequence: The predecessor's exact rho=.20 q95 pair-cost values are not merely conservative for fixed rho>=.20; they are pathwise conservative for arbitrary history-varying predictable hazards bounded below by .20 under the stated sign-clock assumptions. This is stronger than a distributional or expectation-only bound.

stress_tests.interpretation: Simulation is a diagnostic only; the pathwise inequality follows deterministically from the shared-uniform construction and does not rely on the finite stress-test counts.

current_sign_failure_mode.cost_bound_vs_validity: Even if rho_t remains >=.20, letting the discordance decision depend on the current latent sign can preserve pair-cost domination while destroying the conditional sign symmetry needed for exact McNemar/tail FWER calculations.
current_sign_failure_mode.minimal_example: If latent +/- signs are each 1/2 before selection but the pair is retained as discordant with probability .60 for '+' and .20 for '-', then among observed discordances P(+)=.60/(.60+.20)=.75, not .50.
current_sign_failure_mode.guard: The rho robustness claim must therefore require either current-sign-blind discordance selection or an explicit model/correction proving the retained discordant sign law. A lower bound on rho alone is insufficient for FWER validity.

results: Predictable history-dependent discordance rates bounded below by .20 cannot make paired-observation cost worse than the fixed .20 benchmark for a sign-clock stopping rule; the domination is pathwise under shared uniforms.

Prior signs, prior waiting times, candidate stage, and accumulated curtailed state may influence rho_t without invalidating the cost bound, provided the current latent sign is not used and the sign law remains valid.
Outcome-dependent retention is the sharp failure mode: cost robustness and inferential validity separate cleanly.
rejected_or_narrowed_generalizations: Rejected: history-varying rho_t by itself invalidates the predecessor q95 cost bound. Predictable rho_t>=.20 is pathwise dominated by fixed .20.

Rejected: rho_t>=.20 alone is enough for the full statistical guarantee. Current-sign-dependent retention can distort the observed sign law catastrophically while still satisfying the pair-cost lower-hazard bound.
Narrowed: the coupling does not cover hard pair caps, rho_t<.20, or stopping/selection that changes which latent sign sequence the inferential test targets.

frontier.action: Add batched and parallel rollout occupancy to the certified policies and optimize wall-clock q95 rather than only total pair count; model batch fill, candidate-level serialization, and accelerator concurrency explicitly.
Broaden r beyond {10,20,30,50}; use the now-complete 1800-3300 certificate as a baseline and test whether intermediate depths produce materially better pair-cost/worst-power breakpoints.
Formalize a missingness/retention diagnostic that tests current-sign blindness or corrects sign-dependent discordance selection before exact paired inference is admitted.
Evaluate stochastic within-candidate shallow-scan/deepen rules under exact lifetime FWER and wall-clock cost.

frontier.exact_next_action: Construct a batched/parallel execution-cost model for the 29 certified pair-count breakpoints, compute elapsed-time and accelerator-occupancy q95 under realistic batch sizes/concurrency, and identify where pair-count Pareto ordering reverses.
